name: erp-mini-market
description: MiniMarket ERP - backend NestJS + Prisma, frontend Vue 3 + Vite (monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @erp/backend" "npm run dev -w @erp/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @erp/backend && npm run build -w @erp/frontend
